name: @larvit/log
description: Structured logging with a tiny API, plus OTLP export of logs and traces from Node, Bun, Deno, browsers and React Native. No OpenTelemetry SDK, no dependencies.

scripts.build: rm -rf index.js index.js.map types && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild index.ts --bundle --minify-syntax --format=esm --target=es2020 --sourcemap=external --sources-content=false --log-level=warning --outfile=index.js && npm run replace-version-string && uglifyjs index.js -m --source-map "content='index.js.map'" -o index.js
scripts.build-tests: npm run build && rm -rf .tmp/test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && cp index.js .tmp/test/index.js
scripts.ci: npm run build-tests && npm run test-node
scripts.lint: eslint index.ts log otlp primitives tracing tests
scripts.lint-fix: eslint --fix index.ts log otlp primitives tracing tests
scripts.replace-version-string: grep -o '"version": "[^"]*"' package.json | cut -d'"' -f4 | xargs -I {} sed -i.bak 's/__version__/{}/g' index.js && rm -f index.js.bak
scripts.test: npm run test-docker && npm run test-browser
scripts.test-browser: docker build -t larvit-log-test-browser --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v$(node -p "require('./package.json').devDependencies.playwright")-noble . && docker run --rm --init --ipc=host larvit-log-test-browser npm run ci-browser
scripts.test-docker: docker build -t larvit-log-test-node ${NODE_IMAGE:+--build-arg BASE_IMAGE="$NODE_IMAGE"} . && docker run --rm larvit-log-test-node npm run ci
scripts.test-otlp: docker build -t larvit-log-test-node . && docker run --rm larvit-log-test-node sh -c "npm run build >/dev/null && cat index.js" > index.js && node e2e-tests/run-otlp-tests.mjs
